quote: In May 2026, FCX entered into a new $3.0 billion, five-year senior unsecured revolving credit facility that matures in May 2031, which replaced its prior revolving credit facility, and Cerro Verde entered into a new $350 million, five-year, senior unsecured revolving credit facility that matures in May 2031, which replaced its prior revolving credit facility.
note: Opened FCX SEC Exhibit 99.1 2026-10-02 (shared URL with stake purchase).
